tags.note: The sky-walk that crosses over Bedford Street is the easiest way to get on campus from the parking garage. It leads you right in between Masterton and Luther Bonney.
This continued path from the sky-walk will take you the flattest and quickest route to the Science Building and Planetarium.

tags.name: Sullivan Gymnasium
tags.note: There is one entrance to the gym at the ground level and one elevator to navigate lower levels of the gym.

tags.name: Luther Bonney Hall
tags.note: There is a front entrance that has an elevator to the right of the stairs. The back entrance brings you onto the first floor where there is also an elevator.

tags.name: Masterton Hall
tags.note: There is a ramp in the front of the building that will lead you to the basement floor of Masterton where you can find an elevator to navigate the rest of the building. Also a skywalk to connect two halves.

tags.name: Payson Smith Hall
tags.note: There is a ramp on the far side of Payson Smith closest to Falmouth Street and Brighton. This ramp leads you into the first floor where there is an elevator.

tags.name: Science Building
tags.note: Front and Back accessible entrances and a first floor elevator that only goes so many floors.

tags.name: USM Surrenden Street Parking Garage
tags.note: Elevators at three corners of the building and handicap parking spots on all levels.
